events.headline: Asian shares head for worst week since 2020 as AI rout deepens
events.summary: Asian markets plunged as Anthropic's debut failed to revive the AI trade; the MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan index was down 8.5% for the week. Dollar strength and risk aversion intensified.

events.headline: European shares head for steepest weekly drop since March
events.summary: The STOXX 600 dropped 1% and headed for a weekly decline exceeding 4.5%, with ASML and other semiconductor shares falling more than 4%. Investors questioned returns on AI spending after Anthropic's IPO.

events.headline: AI surge could strain US capacity and overheat economy, Fed's Goolsbee says
events.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee warned that AI data-center investment could intensify near-term inflation before productivity benefits materialize. He said evidence did not yet indicate inflation returning to 2% without further action.

events.headline: US AI chip curbs hit China tech stocks, spur self-sufficiency push
events.summary: New US restrictions on overseas access to advanced AI compute weighed on Chinese technology shares. Alibaba projected cloud growth slowing to 30%-45% next year from 53%, while Tencent highlighted domestic inference chips.

events.headline: Gold set for worst week in eight months as firm dollar, Fed hike bets weigh
events.summary: Spot gold fell about 1.9% to $3,552 per ounce and was on track for an 8.5% weekly loss as dollar strength and expectations of December Fed tightening weighed on bullion.

events.headline: Oil prices gain as Houthi attacks on Riyadh raise supply concerns
events.summary: Oil futures rose modestly on renewed Middle East supply concerns after Houthi attacks on Riyadh and reports of tanker disruptions. Brent nevertheless headed for a third weekly decline amid surplus expectations.

events.headline: India's AI-free appeal draws record foreign buying, earnings will decide if it lasts
events.summary: Foreign investors put roughly $12 billion into Indian equities in November as investors diversified away from AI-heavy markets. The Nifty 50 rose more than 11% for the month, but analysts cautioned that sustained inflows depend on earnings.
